newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF SGS stake worth up to 4.1 bln fr - paper.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF SGS stake worth up to 4.1 bln fr - paper.

text.p: The 17.3 percent stake in semiconductor company SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV owned by Thomson-CSF would yield between 3.6 and 4.1 billion francs at maximum, the Le Figaro newspaper said.
Lagardere Groupe has said it plans to sell Thomson-CSF's stake in SGS.
On Wednesday, the government decided Lagardere could acquire state-owned Thomson SA for a symbolic franc.
Thomson SA has a 58 percent stake in Thomson-CSF and Lagardere plans to buy out the minorities.

At current market prices, the 17.3 percent stake would be worth some 7.3 billion francs but Thomson-CSF is bound to a shareholders agreement and has to sell to other French SGS shareholders France Telecom and CEA Industries at a price established in 1993.
